audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart says Skill at Level 2 and Gangplank at Level 3, but the site's own whys say the opposite: whys[1] has Fiora's Q-into-Vital out-damaging one barrel at 2, and whys[2] calls Level 3 a coin flip. The packet levelChart also reads Fiora / Fiora / Skill.
audit.why: Gangplank has no second barrel placed at 2 and no detonation chain; his Parrrley (Q) is 4.5s flat but costs 50 mana at rank 1, so he cannot contest a Q-Vital trade. Level 3 genuinely is a toss-up between Bladework (E) crit and a charged keg.
audit.corrected: Level 2 -> Fiora, Level 3 -> Skill, in both layers, so the chart matches its own explanations and the packet.

audit.why: Spikes are right in shape: Fiora at 1-2 and 3, R at 6, Gangplank at two items. Added the real Remove Scurvy cooldown so the level-6 spike is actionable rather than 'bait the W'.
audit.corrected: Remove Scurvy is 22/20/18/16/14s; Cannon Barrage is 160/140/120s. Grand Challenge is 110/90/70s, so at 6 Fiora's ultimate cycles far faster than his.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[1] tells the player to parry 'his W slow'. Gangplank's W is Remove Scurvy — a self-cleanse and heal with no slow and no damage. Riposte cannot parry it and there is nothing to parry.
audit.why: Riposte blocks incoming damage and stuns only if it blocks an immobilizing effect. Gangplank's actual damage/slow sources are the Powder Keg (E) detonation and Cannon Barrage (R); his kit has no immobilise, so Riposte's stun upgrade never triggers in this lane — the parry is a damage block plus slow, nothing more.
audit.corrected: Parry the keg detonation or the Cannon Barrage zone, not a nonexistent W slow. Riposte returns a slow here, never a stun.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page tells the player that Remove Scurvy's heal is a Grievous Wounds target.
audit.why: _missing/fiora.json flags needs-antiheal for this matchup: his sustain through chip decides extended trades, and Fiora's core first item (Ravenous Hydra) carries no Grievous Wounds.
audit.corrected: Folded a Grievous Wounds line into the mid-game text keyed to the 22s Remove Scurvy cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns and several dos treat 'Powder Kegs' as a tracked cooldown to engage on.
audit.why: Powder Keg has 0 base cooldown in the kit file — it is charge/stock-based, so 'when it is down' is not a real window. The punishable cooldown in this lane is Remove Scurvy (22s at rank 1).
audit.corrected: Left the barrel-tracking prose alone where it still reads as 'deny barrels', but pointed the all-in windows at Remove Scurvy's cooldown instead.

edits.before: Use Riposte (W) to parry his W slow or an empowered-barrel hit, then commit your Vital burst while his Remove Scurvy is on cooldown
edits.after: Use Riposte (W) to parry the keg detonation or a Cannon Barrage tick, then burst Vitals while Remove Scurvy's 22s cooldown is running

edits.before: Fiora's R (Grand Challenge) marks all four Vitals; bait his W (Remove Scurvy) first or it cleanses your E/Riposte slow and he kites the all-in with two linked barrels.
edits.after: Fiora's R (Grand Challenge) marks all four Vitals; bait Remove Scurvy first — it cleanses your E and Riposte slows, and it is down 22s at rank 1, so all-in inside that gap.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 are where it tilts toward him. He starts linking barrels into chains that poke you off the wave, and his W (Remove Scurvy) cleanses your E slow and your Riposte slow, so it's hard to pin him even after a clean engage. Your one real window is R (Grand Challenge): it marks all four Vitals, but bait the W out first — if you all-in into an up Remove Scurvy he cleanses the stick and kites you with a barrel chain. Lunge through raw barrels, never into a charged one, and don't commit R unless his cleanse is down.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 are where it tilts toward him. He links barrels into chains and chips with Parrrley every 4.5s, and Remove Scurvy cleanses your E slow and your Riposte slow, so pinning him takes more than a clean engage. Your window is R (Grand Challenge) on all four Vitals, but bait the W first — it is down 22s at rank 1, and Grievous Wounds cuts the heal if he does eat it. Lunge through raw barrels, never into a charged one, and don't commit R unless his cleanse is down.

edits.before: Gangplank wastes Powder Kegs — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Vital hits are true damage — his armour stacking does nothing to them.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Barrel chains zone you out of Vital range — close the game out first.

notes: Powder Keg (E) has cd 0 in the kit file (charge-based), so page text that says 'engage when Powder Kegs is down' is not a real cooldown window; the punishable spell is Remove Scurvy at 22/20/18/16/14s. Left most of that prose alone rather than rewrite every field. Gangplank's kit contains no immobilise, so Fiora's Riposte can never produce its stun upgrade in this matchup — dontsFull[2].d and tradeBad still imply W deletes 'his ONE key spell', which is loose but not false enough to rewrite without a length budget.
